title: Songs for the Wild by Stevan Pasero & Christopher Bock CD 2009
descriptionText: "Songs for the Wild" by Stevan Pasero is a CD album released in 2009 under the record label CD Baby. Produced by a collaboration of Christopher Bock, Russell Bond, and Stevan Pasero, the album features World Music genre with songs sung in English. With a focus on the beauty of nature and the interconnectedness of all living beings, the music on this CD transports listeners to a wild and natural state of mind, making it perfect for those who appreciate a blend of traditional and modern musical styles.
